item.title: Farnborough’s Pitch to Be Assessed Tomorrow Morning
item.description: Following communication from Farnborough regarding pitch conditions ahead of tomorrow’s fixture, the pitch will be assessed first thing in the morning. The post Farnborough’s Pitch to Be Assessed Tomorrow Morning appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Pitch Inspection Update: Farnborough
item.description: A pitch inspection will take place at 10:30 am ahead of today’s fixture at Farnborough. The post Pitch Inspection Update: Farnborough appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Game on at Farnborough!
item.description: Following an inspection by the Match Referee in conjunction with a local Match Official, the pitch has been passed as playable, provided there is no further significant rain before kick-off. The post Game on at Farnborough! appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: ✍️ Daggers loan in Will Lannin-Sweet
item.description: Dagenham & Redbridge are delighted to announce the signing of defender Will Lannin-Sweet on a one-month loan from Arsenal. The post ✍️ Daggers loan in Will Lannin-Sweet appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Farnborough game off due to heavy downpour
item.description: Due to a heavy downpour over the last hour, the Referee has inspected the pitch and deemed that it is unplayable, therefore today's game against Farnborough has now been postponed. The post Farnborough game off due to heavy downpour appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: One Week to Go: Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day 2026
item.description: We are just one week away from one of the most important dates in the Dagenham & Redbridge FC calendar, Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day. The post One Week to Go: Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day 2026 appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Blood Donor Sessions At The Daggers
item.description: The Daggers are supporting the NHS with regular blood donor sessions being held in the Ted Hardy Suite at Victoria Road. We have a number of sessions this month, including today, Wednesday the 4th, Monday the 9th, Tuesday the 17th, and Wednesday the 25th. Please don’t attend sessions unless you have an appointment. For more […] The post Blood Donor Sessions At The Daggers appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Kalambayi to stay at Kidderminster for rest of season
item.description: Dagenham & Redbridge can confirm that defender Paul Kalambayi has extended his loan spell with Kidderminster Harriers, and will stay with the National League North Side until the end of the season. The post Kalambayi to stay at Kidderminster for rest of season appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: De Silva returns to Sutton United
item.description: We can confirm that Dillon De Silva has returned to Sutton United following the conclusion of his loan deal. The post De Silva returns to Sutton United appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Hemmings extends Kidderminster loan
item.description: Dagenham & Redbridge can confirm that Ashley Hemmings has extended his loan with Kidderminster Harriers, with the forward set to stay at the National League North side until 1st March. The post Hemmings extends Kidderminster loan appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.
